name: Quest AI Runner
vision_statement: A Quest user's AI system continuously evolves to help the user continuously evolve towards their intents.
opportunities: Other products that need an AI which works from a person's own goals and material could reuse this engine, so the grounding, the standard for delegated work and the scope fences are built once and shared.
solution_coherence: Quest AI Runner turns what a Quest user asks into work that moves their intents, and Quest Self is the one assistant that does it. Quest Self first learns from Quest Consciousness who is asking and what they are growing toward. It then reads the account and the person's own material through Quest Body. It hands each request to Intelligence, which understands it against what the person is working toward. When the request needs more than the person's own material, Quest Self reaches the outside through World.
